title: Periodic Trends and Chemical Properties
purpose: Use periodic patterns to reason about atomic properties.
simulationReview: Direct simulation/resource link is provided in P01.html and in directSimulationUrl.
assessmentStimulusNeeded: Periodic trend graph or periodic table excerpt
simulationVirtualLabReviewRequirement: Required for atomic models, periodic trends, energy levels, and spectra
directSimulationStudentTask: After the simulation opens, use the atom-building workspace with protons, neutrons, and electrons. Change one particle type at a time: first protons, then neutrons, then electrons. After each change, read the element name, charge, and mass number shown by the simulation. Record a table with protons, neutrons, electrons, element identity, mass number, charge, and the lesson connection for Periodic Trends and Chemical Properties.
simulationReviewImplementation: Student-facing lesson includes one exact direct simulation/resource link plus adjacent step-by-step directions for what to open, click/use, observe, record, and connect to the lesson standard.
simulationSourceReference: OpenStax Chemistry 2e; CK-12; PhET periodic table resources if appropriate
